notes.title: Red Line crowdfunding campaign for merch is live now
notes.notes:
Hi, we have set up a new merch campaign on Chinese crowdfunding platform Modian. For those who played and enjoyed the game, you can keep your favorite characters‘ goods and support the dev team in future development through different merch projects. An art book will be attached as a free gift for everyone who supported this project once we surpassed the set goal in double. More info can be viewed on: [url=https://zhongchou.modian.com/item/127672.html#projectDetail]Campaign Page[/url]

For those who are not based in Mainland China, we are sorry that you might not receive any physical merch due to high shipping cost. Make sure you have checked the shipment accessibility before supporting us. 

The campaign ends on 30th Aug, don't miss out if you are interested. Join our community and follow the publisher @indienova on Twitter for the latest news. Thank you for playing and supporting!

notes.title: Red Line Is Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hey all, we are glad to announce that our pixel horror game, Red Line, has been released! Thank you all for waiting and we hope you can enjoy this small pixel game that we put a lot of effort into. We are also offering a 20% discount for the release hope you won’t miss out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43149467/e0ebfb6b63357632befe05e35a55cf32d52f07f2.jpg[/img]

[h3]In the estimated 4-6 hours of gameplay, you can expect these unique experiences:
[/h3][list]
[*] Story revolving around dual protagonists in different worlds is told from multiple views
[*] Episodic narrative, with unique tragedies befalling the families behind each and every door 
[*] Seamless switching between investigation, chatting, and puzzle solving provides an utterly immersive detective experience
[*] Stunning and picturesque in-game graphics imbue this pixel game with a dynamic visual style
[*] Well-designed sound effects and BGM selections are the icing on the cake that give players a more terrifying atmosphere.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2143050/?=en

notes.title: Pixel horror game Red Line will be officially released on July 20th
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Today Red Line has a brand-new trailer, and also a release date! The offical version will see you soon on July 20th!

[previewyoutube=HTGrMaESFh8;full][/previewyoutube]

Red Line is a story-driven horror game with moderate puzzles. Players can control two protagonists in two worlds to interact with different residents, investigate items, solve puzzles to unlock memories, and put clues together to reveal the truth of the past. By recreating certain moments spent in the apartment, resolve the regrets and obsessions of the characters, and help them embark on the next journey.

A demo will be downloadable for interested players during the Steam Next Fest now, featuring English support for the first time. We hope you enjoy it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2143050/
